content.text:
I finished the first quest, "A Dry Hand in a Wet City", then ended the session and answered the closing questions.

- **The quest:** S'Tabi sent me to Tilts-The-Jug (the "Argonian Boat Captain"). She asked me to get a stolen blue jasper necklace back from a dock thief's strongbox. The box was unlocked, so I never used the lockpicks. I returned the necklace and got 100 gold.
- **The Night-Reed Chapter:** I took the trip to Lilmoth and went down the trapdoor. Flaa Heet took me in as a Lookout of the Night-Reed Chapter. That completed the quest.
- **Next quest:** "The Drowned Lockbox" started straight away. I did not pursue it. The next step is to ask Bent-Spine what work he has.
- **Problems I reported:** Nearly all dialogue was placeholder text, so the characters had no voice. The boat captain was labelled "Argonian Boat Captain" instead of Tilts-The-Jug. Flaa Heet appeared where I expected Bent-Spine. Nobody reacted to me taking the necklace in front of a crowd.
